title: AARO appointed to head a space tiger team on UAP in space

tellings.quote:
Arrow was um appointed to head some sort
of a space tiger restudy team to examine
UAPs in space of some kind or another.

plain: AARO, the Pentagon office set up to investigate UAP (the official term for unidentified flying objects), was put in charge of a special study team to look at such objects in space. A researcher named Maaneli Derakhshani tells Michels this without naming a source, and is vague on the details, but it would mean the military is now formally studying unexplained things beyond the atmosphere.
